description: Wire a texture set to a material in a project: the colour map to `map`, the normal map to `normalMap`, the ambient-occlusion / roughness / metalness map to `aoMap` + `roughnessMap` (+ `metalnessMap` when the set is metallic), the SAME repeat on every map, and roughness 1 (THREE multiplies the roughness map by the material's roughness; the default 0.5 would halve it). Creates one Texture per map, or reuses a Texture of the project already on that image. MaterialStandard / Physical get every map; Lambert / Phong / Toon get map, normalMap and aoMap; Basic is refused (unlit). `repeat` is how often the tile repeats across the surface; or give `worldSize` in metres (repeat = worldSize / the set's tile size), e.g. 1000 for a 1 km terrain with 1 m gravel. Kept at once in the project's live copy: every R3 tab with the project open shows it.

material.description: The material to wire: its entityRef or id (r3_project_load), e.g. "material_ground".

repeat.description: How often the texture repeats across the surface (the same on every map). Default 1.

worldSize.description: Or: the surface size in metres; repeat = worldSize / the set's tile size (1 m for the presets), e.g. 1000 for a 1 km terrain.

name: r3_texture_apply

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Put a texture set on a material
